_template_meta.name: lead-qualification
_template_meta.description: Outbound lead-qualification call. Routes the caller to hot/warm/cold paths based on their answers, then either books a follow-up, schedules a callback, or marks them DNC. Webhook fires post-call to update CRM.

nodes.name: Greet and introduce why you're calling
nodes.instructions: Greet by name. State who you are and the ONE-line reason for the call. Ask if it's a good time to talk for 2 minutes.

transitions.label: Caller is busy, asked to be called another time
Caller is not interested at all, wants to be removed
Wrong person, ask for the right one

nodes.name: Probe the pain / need
nodes.instructions: Ask one open-ended question about their current situation related to our offering. Listen for: signal of pain, scale (small/mid/large), and timing (now/soon/later). Capture into slots: 'pain_signal' (string), 'scale' (string), 'timing' (string).

transitions.label: Caller has a clear pain AND timing is now/soon
Caller has some interest but no urgency
Caller has no real need or fit

nodes.name: Hot lead — book a follow-up
nodes.instructions: The caller is qualified. Briefly confirm the value prop, then propose a 15-min discovery call with a sales rep. Get their preferred time.

transitions.label: Caller agreed to a follow-up call and gave a time
Caller wants to receive info first by email/WhatsApp
Caller has an objection that needs handling

nodes.name: Acknowledge and respond to objection
nodes.instructions: Acknowledge the objection without saying 'I understand' robotically. Respond once. Then ask: would they like to learn more, or should we end here?

transitions.label: Caller is convinced, willing to book

nodes.name: Warm lead — schedule callback later
nodes.instructions: Thank them. Ask when would be a better time to follow up (in days/weeks). Get a specific window.

transitions.label: Caller declined to give a window

nodes.name: Cold — polite close
nodes.instructions: Thank them politely. Ask if it's ok to remove them from outreach, OR if they'd prefer occasional updates.

transitions.label: Caller wants to be removed from all outreach
Caller is fine with occasional updates

nodes.name: Schedule a callback
nodes.instructions: Apologize for the bad timing. Ask for a specific day and time to call back. Confirm before ending.

nodes.farewell: Excellent. You'll get a calendar invite shortly. Talk to you then.
Thanks for the time. We'll be in touch.
Thanks for chatting. Have a great day.
Got it, I'll call you back then. Have a great day.
Understood, I'll remove you from our list. Sorry for the disturbance.
Sorry to bother you, have a great day.

nodes.name: qualification_outcome
nodes.extraction_prompt: Classify the outcome and extract qualification signals.

schema_fields.name: outcome
schema_fields.description: hot_booked | warm_callback | cold | dnc | wrong_person | no_answer
